ValidationRule.description: To validate Additional Correspondence reviewed checkbox to be true only when Case Status is Closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ($Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false), NOT(ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed")), IDR_Additional_Correspondence_reviewed__c = True, ISCHANGED(Status))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Additional Correspondence reviewed checkbox cannot be true when case is Open
